You name what your enemy fears losing, then flick a glowing coal from your fingers toward them. The ember flares as it strikes.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within 5 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

Name something it stands to lose and cast a burning coal. The threat is a flourish, not a compulsory bargain.

Weak
3 fire damage.
Standard
3 fire damage and Frightened 1 of you.
Strong
5 fire damage and Frightened 1 of you.
